text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money, because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality, because everyone follows the same standards and writes cleaner code. In short, code reviews are not just about finding mistakes; they help the whole team grow and produce better software together.
